note: What the route signposts say. tools/signposts.py places a post at every town exit (both ends of every route leg), every sub-region transition along a leg, and every junction where a place's own path leaves a route. The front of each sign faces the traveller going the way the text names; the back faces the other way. Names are working names until the towns have display names (data/towns.json display_name, which wins once set); change them here and re-run the tool. The location titles (tools/location_titles.py) read the same names, so every titled settlement has one here, including the ones no sign names.
why_offset: beside the road, on the traveller's right, never on it

junctions.why: the forest's mansion spur leaves Route 1 here (tools/maze_forest.py spur_mansion)

no_sign.displaced_city: hidden on purpose: the waystone inside is the reward for finding it once

notices_why: Signs that explain rather than name (the owner, 2026-10-06: 'Victory Road and the Rift finale are explained in the world'; docs/world-building/POST_GYM8_DIRECTION.md). A route notice is seated like a junction post, beside its route nearest `at`, keeping clear of every other post; a wall notice hangs at a measured position on the face its record names. Lines are authored to fit (at most 15 characters, at most 4) and are never re-wrapped.

notices.why: CRITICAL_PATH_WALK_2 item 6, 'nothing points to the HQ': the Victory Road line comes up the trunk to the Sink Gate's exit (3695, 3394) on the Deep's south-east lip (derived/deep_city/plan.json sink_gate, from ring 0 at y66 to the lip at y82); the HQ door (3443, 67, 3282) is on ring 0, west. Seated on the Rift floor OUTSIDE the pit (rift_deep.model ring -1, checked by tests/test_signposts_notices.py), about 70 blocks before the gate; the route's own transition_10 post is inside the pit (a defect recorded in POST_GYM8_DIRECTION.md).

Victory Road explained where it starts: the caves' mouth is (3560, 1, 3064) under the Deep's north face (data/vr_caves.json mouth, toward north; tunnel x3557-3563). This sign hangs on the face east of the tunnel, at head height for a player standing on the Deep's floor (paving at y0). Measured from the built packs 2026-10-06: the face block behind it, (3566, 2, 3063), is filled solid by cobblers_deep (distortion deepslate over the void, y-4 to 65); the sign's own block is cleared to air by cobblers_deep (y1-85) and paved under by cobblers_deep_city at y0; no pack writes it. The vr_caves shell stops at x3565.
